summary.headline: Patel Retail Q1 FY27 total income rose 69.35% YoY to INR310.24 crores, but EBITDA margin fell to about 6.3% on raw material intensity.
summary.overview: Total income reached INR310.24 crores, up 69.35% YoY from INR183.19 crores, while EBITDA grew 23.92% to INR19.68 crores and PAT rose 37.43% to INR9.52 crores (EPS INR2.85). Management attributed the margin compression (about 133 bps decline cited, and a 233 bps figure also mentioned) to a higher raw-material-intensity mix in manufacturing, export and commodity-linked business amid volatile raw material prices and odd order timing. The company added stores at Rasayani and Babgaon in Q1 and opened its 53rd store at Uran (Raigad) after quarter-end, and expanded Indian Chaska into Madhya Pradesh. Management guided to positive operating cash flow by H1 FY27 and 8 to 10 new stores in FY27.

decline of 133 bps as stated (233 bps also cited in same answer)

financial_highlights.value: around INR101 crores (as referenced by analyst)

financial_highlights.metric: Private label contribution to retail sales

segments.name: Retail (Patel R-Mart)
segments.commentary: 53 stores after Uran opening; average monthly sales per store put at INR80 lakh to INR1 crore, mature-store sales about INR20,000 per sq ft; ticket size INR500 to INR1,000; wastage below 0.1%. Payback about 24 months.

segments.name: Manufacturing / food processing
segments.commentary: Utilisation currently 50% to 55%, targeted at around 80% to 82% by FY27-FY28; automation expected to cut labour cost and improve quality consistency. Private label share of domestic sales cited at 45%, export sales at 37%.

segments.name: Exports and B2B
segments.commentary: Management stated about 40% of revenue from exports and rest from manufacturing and retail; export contribution to bottom line cited as 35% to 40%. These figures were not reconciled in the call.

segments.name: Indian Chaska (brand)
segments.commentary: Expanded to Madhya Pradesh in August 2026, taking presence to eight states and one union territory; MP averaging INR10 lakh to INR12 lakh per month; whole spices category to be added this quarter.

segments.name: Online / quick commerce
segments.commentary: App has more than 50,000 downloads but online sales were around INR50 lakh in Q1; private label not yet listed on Blinkit or Zepto, with per-SKU terms being finalised; pilot quick commerce running from first stores.

segments.name: Apparel and fashion (general merchandise)
segments.commentary: 8% to 9% of revenue; inventory holding period 15 to 20 days.

guidance_outlook: EBITDA margin expected to move back toward 8% to 9% over coming quarters, with margin in Q1 not treated as steady state.
Positive operating cash flow expected by H1 FY27; conversion of current assets built up in FY26 into cash targeted.
8 to 10 new stores targeted by FY27, each expected to generate about INR1 crore per month in revenue.
Capacity utilisation targeted at around 80% to 82% by end-FY27 to FY28.
Expansion into Western suburbs and Pune/PCMC over the next five years, cluster-based; more gaps still being identified.
capex_capacity: Current processing utilisation 50% to 55%; medium-term target 80% to 82%.
New store payback about 24 months to recover capex and inventory rotation; store size and investment about 5,000 to 6,000 per sq ft as stated.
Automation being introduced at processing facilities, aimed at labour cost reduction and unified quality.
Store additions in Q1 at Rasayani and Babgaon; Uran (53rd store) opened after quarter-end.
Pune/PCMC store economics said to be broadly similar to existing network; 2 to 3 pockets identified.
demand_pricing: Management attributed Q1 margin decline to higher raw material intensity in export and commodity-linked business and volatile raw material prices.
Mature-store sales about INR20,000 per sq ft (retail); average monthly sales per store INR80 lakh to INR1 crore.
Online remains touch-and-feel in Tier-2/3/4 locations; society-focused activation and 30-60 minute delivery trials underway.
Private label planned as combo packs (e.g., rice, dal, salt) to make per-SKU listing and ad costs sustainable on quick commerce.
Plans to launch 2 to 3 more Indian Chaska categories (e.g., protein-related) from next quarter, targeting categories with INR2,000 to 3,000 crore market size.

qa_highlights.question: What must improve to move EBITDA margin from about 6.3% back to 8% to 9%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Q1 decline was due to higher raw material intensity in manufacturing, export and commodity-linked mix and volatile raw material prices; it expects improvement in coming quarters and not treating Q1 as steady state.

qa_highlights.question: Positive operating cash flow by H1 FY27 still on track, and working capital outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said Q1 balance sheet and cash flow not yet published; expects much better operating cash flow by H1, converting FY26 current-asset build into cash.

qa_highlights.question: How many new stores in FY27 and revenue contribution?
qa_highlights.answer: 8 to 10 stores by FY27, expected to contribute around INR1 crore per month in revenue.

qa_highlights.question: Current utilisation and target?
qa_highlights.answer: Current utilisation 50% to 55%; targeted around 80% to 82% in the medium term, by end-FY27 to FY28.

qa_highlights.question: Share of own brands across channels?
qa_highlights.answer: Own brands about 17.5% of overall revenue; private label 17.55% of retail sales, 37% of export sales and 45% of domestic sales as stated by the CFO.

qa_highlights.question: Performance of recently opened stores vs older stores?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said new stores are operationally breakeven since day one, with some growing strongly; payback target about 24 months.

risks_watch: Margin recovery to 8% to 9% depends on raw material cost stability; Q1 EBITDA margin about 6.3%.
Operating cash flow guidance for H1 FY27 unverified; balance sheet and cash flow not yet published; inventory and receivables elevated after FY26 build.
Online and quick commerce traction remains small (about INR50 lakh in Q1) and competition from platform in-house brands noted by analysts.
Internal inconsistencies in disclosed figures (133 bps vs 233 bps margin decline; export share 40% vs 35% to 40% export contribution to bottom line) need clarification.
Store maturity: some stores still not up to mark per management; 8 to 10 new stores in FY27 execution.
summary.management_tone: Management was confident on growth and store ramp-up but cautious and somewhat non-specific on margin and cash flow timing; several answers deferred figures (e.g., online targets, five-year scale) and the call had audio breaks during key answers.
key_quotes: Total income stood at INR310.24 crores, registering a robust 69.35% year -on-year growth compared with INR183.19 crores in Q1 FY '26.
The payback period for my new store is almost 24 months to recover the entire capex and the rotation of the inventory
So, madam, currently we haven't published the balance sheet and the cash flow statement for the Q1. Of course, by the H1, we are expecting the much better positive cash flow from operations.
The private level contribution to our retail sales is almost 17.55%, and for our rest of sales is almost 37% in my export sales and 45% in my domestic sales.
Right. So, the current utilization is between 50% to 55%, but in the medium term by the end of FY27, FY28, we plan on getting this utilization to around 80%, 80%, 82%.

growth.why: Management guides 8-10 new stores in FY27 (about INR1 crore/month each) and utilisation rising from 50-55% to 80-82% by end-FY27/FY28 via automation, with Uran store already opened, but no capex or order figures were given, so backing is partial; Q1 total income +69.35% and EBITDA +23.92% YoY.
